title: Coefficient tower evaluations and finite trace constructions
statement: Define the lifted valuation ring, the derived evaluation and quotient-transition functors on its module towers, the dualizing compact-support tower, and finite traces. The finite trace is the actual ordinary etale exceptional counit followed by derived coefficient restriction and point sections; its target comparison uses the regular coefficient module. The setting and constituent notions are those of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower], [lem-coef-finite-dualizing], [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization], [lem-weil-tower-category-levelwise-abelian], [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site].
